title: TEMPO: Temporally-grounded Multi-task Post-training for Large Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.29999v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) describe audio at the clip level but cannot assign timestamps to the events, speakers, or sounds they identify. Despite being essential for downstream tasks like speech recognition and dense audio captioning, timestamping remains a key limitation of most LALMs. We present TEMPO (Temporally-grounded Multi-task Post-training), the first unified model to handle audio, speech, and music timestamping tasks. Our core contribution is a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage built on three innovations: atomic timestamp tokens, a time-aware projector that injects sinusoidal wall-clock encodings into audio frame embeddings, and a distance-aware Gaussian loss. Our training is based on a synthetic-to-real curriculum. translated_title: TEMPO：面向大型音频-语言模型的时间定位多任务后训练
translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）能够在片段级别描述音频，但无法为其识别出的事件、说话人或声音分配时间戳。尽管时间戳标注对于语音识别和密集音频描述等下游任务至关重要，但它仍然是大多数LALMs的关键局限。我们提出了TEMPO（时间定位多任务后训练），这是第一个能够统一处理音频、语音和音乐时间戳任务的模型。我们的核心贡献是一个建立在三项创新之上的监督微调（SFT）阶段：原子时间戳词元、将正弦时钟编码注入音频帧嵌入的时间感知投影器，以及距离感知的高斯损失。我们的训练基于从合成数据到真实数据的课程学习。据我们所知，我们进一步首次将强化学习应用于统一的音频时间戳标注任务，使用带有可验证时间奖励的GRPO直接优化评估指标。
tldr: 提出了TEMPO，首个通过原子时间戳词元、时间感知投影器和距离感知高斯损失三项创新，并结合基于可验证时间奖励的强化学习，统一处理音频、语音和音乐时间戳标注任务的大型音频-语言模型后训练框架。
en_tdlr: TEMPO is the first unified post-training framework that enables large audio-language models to handle audio, speech, and music timestamping tasks through atomic timestamp tokens, a time-aware projector, a distance-aware Gaussian loss, and reinforcement learning with verifiable temporal rewards.
